_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score remains inside Hope (63-70) with funding/momentum still well below 2019 froth levels and no ±2 breaker confirmed; coil base rate favors HOLD.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly HOLD/CAUTION coil; narrative only supplies a bullish single-venue flow datapoint without forward phase agreement
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC stays rangebound, composite holds 63-70, funding stays near neutral
next_move.invalidated_if: 30d momentum and funding close the gap into Optimism territory, or CVD rolls over while skew and gold stay bid (break into Disbelief)
